newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-CENTRAL BANK RESERVES RISE IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-CENTRAL BANK RESERVES RISE IN MARCH.

text.p: The gold and foreign currency reserves of the central bank increased to 8.15 billion kroons in March from 7.54 billion kroons in Febraury, the central bank said on Tuesday.
The bank's reserve of gold was stable at 37.7 million kroons while convertible foreign currency reserves increased to 8.14 billion kroons from 7.55 billion kroons.
Foreign loans in February were 42.2 million kroons in March, versus 42.1 million kroons in February.
